To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we develop an optimal energy-efficient flight speed algorithm for UAV-assisted computing with a realistic energy model, which is validated by simulations and experiments.

1) we formulate a novel flight speed scheduling problem for edge computing with an energy-efficient propulsion model, 2) we develop optimal and online heuristic algorithms for solving this problem, 3) we provide a diagram to analyze and visualize this problem, and 4) we conduct extensive simulations to demonstrate the efficiency of our algorithms.

(1) We formulate a novel energy-efficient speed scheduling problem for UAV-assisted computation offloading in edge computing, and develop an optimal offline algorithm and an online heuristic to solve this problem, and (2) Simulation results demonstrate that the online heuristic is near-optimal.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following research questions:
the energy-efficient flight speed of a UAV for edge computing.
the problem of optimal energy-efficient flight speed allocation for UAVs in the context of edge computing.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed speed scheduling algorithm is optimal for the offline version, and near optimal for the online version.
this work is one of the first to study UAV-assisted edge computation, and we propose an energy-efficient flight speed algorithm to minimize the energy consumed by UAV for edge computation.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a new diagram to visualize and study the EESS problem, and proposed a novel speed scheduling algorithm for the UAV-assisted edge computation.
we have proposed a novel UAV speed scheduling problem, which is different from existing work, for UAV-assisted IoT edge computing.
we have developed a novel diagram to model UAV speed scheduling for deadline driven edge computing with a realistic energy consumption model.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, in addition to the flight time, the energy cost of UAV is also determined by the flight speed and the flight altitude.
the UAV should fly at the minimum speed that satisfies the deadline constraint of each task to minimize the total energy consumption.
the flight speed scheduling is a promising solution for the energy efficiency of edge computing with a UAV.
